description: Bold V8 power, a silver exterior, and black leather give this 2019 GMC Yukon XL Denali 4x4 a compelling combination of strength and style. Its appeal begins with a straightforward formula: distinctive looks, substantial engine output, and a transmission that lets you choose how involved you want to be. For a buyer drawn to both confident design and muscular performance, this Yukon XL Denali brings those priorities together in one appealing package.  The silver exterior sets a striking tone without relying on a loud color to make its impression. It is a versatile choice with a polished look, equally appealing to those who favor understated style and those who want their vehicle to stand out through presence rather than flash. Paired with the black leather interior, the color combination feels cohesive and timeless. Silver and black complement each other beautifully, giving this GMC an appearance you can appreciate from the outside and enjoy every time you settle in.  Inside, black leather adds a rich visual character that complements the Denali name. The dark interior creates a purposeful contrast with the silver exterior, keeping the overall presentation sophisticated rather than overstated. If you appreciate a vehicle whose interior and exterior feel thoughtfully matched, this combination deserves a closer look. It offers a clear sense of style without depending on bright colors or elaborate contrasts to capture attention.  Beneath that silver exterior is the centerpiece of this Yukon XL Denali: an EcoTec3 6.2L V8 producing 420 horsepower and 460 ft. lbs. of torque. Those figures give the vehicle a performance story with real substance. The horsepower delivers an exciting reason to choose this GMC, while the substantial torque adds to the appeal of its large-displacement V8. For drivers who want engine specifications that inspire enthusiasm rather than simply satisfy a requirement, this 6.2L makes a persuasive case.  Working with the V8 is a 10-speed shiftable automatic transmission. Automatic operation offers a straightforward driving experience, while the shiftable functionality gives you the option to take a more active role in gear selection. That flexibility is an appealing match for an engine with this level of output. Add the 4x4 configuration, and the result is a powertrain combination that gives buyers another strong reason to put this Yukon XL Denali on their shortlist.  What makes this 2019 GMC especially attractive is how naturally its key qualities complement one another. The silver exterior provides the visual impact, black leather brings an upscale touch, and the 420-horsepower V8 supplies the muscle. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down; speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. description: Why BUY from Joyce Koons Honda?     When you choose this Crystal Black Pearl 2025 Honda CR-V EX-L with 19,190 miles, you are not just buying a used vehicle - you are investing in quality, reliability and peace of mind. What this vehicle includes:               Safety and Security Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down; speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. No hybrid battery, no continuously variable transmission, no turbocharger: an engine with port and direct injection, a timing chain, regular unleaded, and a geared automatic that shifts rather than drones, rated in the mid-30s on the highway.
